def mvcc.keyReadSnapR (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT NC : IProp GF) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs)
    (Del : GoString → IProp GF) (rng : Bool) (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (L : IProp GF) :
    IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ q,
        □
          ∀ Φ,
            L ∗ View q m -∗
              ▷
                  ((View q m ∗
                      ∃ m' Rd Tok, Tok ∗ mvcc.keyReadLockedR RT NC r rng rt m' Rd Tok ∗ mvcc.snapThin m m' Del) -∗
                    Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                WP ((intoVal (methods rt.ty go!"RLock" rt.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }})

def mvcc.keyReadSnapCR (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT NC : IProp GF) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs)
    (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (L : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ q,
        □
          ∀ Φ,
            L ∗ View q m -∗
              ▷ ((View q m ∗ ∃ Rd Tok, Tok ∗ mvcc.keyReadLockedR RT NC r true rt m Rd Tok true) -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                WP ((intoVal (methods rt.ty go!"RLock" rt.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }})

theorem mvcc.keyReadSnapR_persistent (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT NC : IProp GF) (r :
    mvcc.CmpRecs) (Del : GoString → IProp GF) (rng : Bool) (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (m : mvcc.Bucket) (L
    : IProp GF) : Persistent (mvcc.keyReadSnapR View RT NC r Del rng rt m L)

def mvcc.keyReadLockedR (RT NC : IProp GF) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) (rng : Bool) (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (m :
    mvcc.Bucket) (Rd : GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (Tok : IProp GF) (cl : Bool := false) : IProp
    GF :=
  iprop((□
        □
          ∀ Φ,
            Tok -∗
              ▷ (RT -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                WP ((intoVal (methods rt.ty go!"RUnlock" rt.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}) ∗
      □ mvcc.keyRangeSpec rt m Rd Tok ∗
        (if rng = true then
            □ mvcc.keyRangeReadSpec rt m Rd Tok ∗
              □ mvcc.keyRangeLimSpec rt m Rd Tok cl ∗
                □ mvcc.rdSplit rt m Rd Tok cl ∗ □ (NC -∗ NC ∗ □ mvcc.metaReadSpecR rt (some r) Rd Tok)
          else True) ∗
          mvcc.rdCap Rd Tok)

                          Φ (intoVal (GoInterface.ok rt))) -∗
                    WP ((intoVal (methods bi.ty go!"ReadTx" bi.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }})

def mvcc.resumeHookM (d' : mvcc.KBReal) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) : IProp GF :=
  if d'.cm = true ∧ r.resumes = true then mvcc.kbHookNil (some d') else iprop(True)

def mvcc.revFinW (s : Loc) (dql : DFrac) (fin : Option w64) (RevP0 RevP : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  match fin with
  | none => iprop(RevP0 -∗ RevP)
  | some x =>
    iprop(∃ RevK0,
        (∀ Ψ,
            RevP0 -∗
              (▷
                  ∀ v,
                    typedPointsto
                        (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
                          go!"compactMainRev" s)
                        v dql -∗
                      RevK0 -∗ Ψ (intoVal ())) -∗
                WP
                  ((intoVal
                      (methods sync.RWMutex.ty.PointerType go!"Lock"
                        (intoVal
                          (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store go!"revMu"
                            s))))
                    (intoVal ()))
                  {{ Ψ }}) ∗
          ∀ Ψ,
            typedPointsto
                (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
                  go!"compactMainRev" s)
                x dql -∗
              RevK0 -∗
                ▷ (RevP -∗ Ψ (intoVal ())) -∗
                  WP
                    ((intoVal
                        (methods sync.RWMutex.ty.PointerType go!"Unlock"
                          (intoVal
                            (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store
                              go!"revMu" s))))
                      (intoVal ()))
                    {{ Ψ }})

def mvcc.restoreViewR (b : GoInterface) (γ : mvcc.StoreNames) (RT : IProp GF) (q : Qp) (ns : Bool)
    (m : mvcc.Bucket) (NC : IProp GF) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) : IProp GF :=
  if ns = true then iprop(mvcc.bucketView γ q ∅ ∗ ⌜m = ∅ ∧ r = mvcc.CmpRecs.empty⌝)
  else iprop(mvcc.bucketViewC γ q m ∗ mvcc.keyCleanReadR b (mvcc.bucketViewC γ) RT NC r)

def mvcc.resumeK (s : Loc) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) (Done Fin : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  if r.resumes = true then
    iprop(∀ Ψ,
        Done -∗
          (▷ ∀ ch err, Fin -∗ Ψ (intoVal ch, intoVal err)) -∗
            WP
              ((intoVal
                  (methods go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.store.ty.PointerType
                    go!"compactLockfree"
                    (intoVal s)))
                (intoVal (r.sched.getD (W64 0))))
              {{ Ψ }})
  else iprop(Done -∗ Fin)

theorem mvcc.keyCleanReadR_frame (b : GoInterface) (View : Qp → mvcc.Bucket → IProp GF) (RT NC :
    IProp GF) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) (X : IProp GF) : mvcc.keyCleanReadR b View RT NC r ⊢
    mvcc.keyCleanReadR b View iprop(RT ∗ X) NC r
